configurePresets.name: x64-debug
configurePresets.description: Default configuration, see BUILD.md. vcpkg builds FFmpeg, DirectXTex and zlib for x64-windows. The vcpkg toolchain is deliberately not set here: $env{VCPKG_ROOT} expands to an invalid path when the variable is empty and would abort the configure at project(); the root CMakeLists.txt resolves VCPKG_ROOT itself, with a fallback to the default VS Build Tools 2026 installation.

configurePresets.name: x64-profile
configurePresets.description: Like x64, plus ENABLE_TRACY=ON and the vcpkg manifest feature 'profiling' (Tracy client and capture/csvexport). Own build folder build-x64-profile; measure in the Release build (build preset x64-profile).

configurePresets.name: x64-tools
configurePresets.description: Like x64-debug, plus BUILD_TOOLS=ON: one configuration builds the games and the tools of both games (Code/Tools, once per game; Zero Hour with the MD suffix). Own build folder build-x64-tools, so build-x64 stays untouched.

configurePresets.name: x64-asan
configurePresets.description: Own build folder build-x64-asan, so the normal Debug build (build-x64) stays untouched during an ASan run. Sets ENABLE_ASAN=ON (/fsanitize=address, MEMORYPOOL_ASAN_BYPASS in GameMemory.cpp); the build copies the ASan runtime clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll next to the game.

configurePresets.name: x64-editor
configurePresets.description: Like x64-debug, plus the new map editor (BUILD_MAPEDITOR_APP=ON) with Qt 6 from the vcpkg feature 'editor'. Own build folder build-x64-editor. The first time, vcpkg builds Qt (about an hour). Build script: tools/mapeditor/bauen_windows.cmd.

configurePresets.name: x64-vulkan
configurePresets.description: Like x64-debug, plus ENABLE_VULKAN=ON and the vcpkg feature 'vulkan'. Own build folder build-x64-vulkan; includes the ctest VulkanShaders (all shader variants to SPIR-V with dxc.exe).

configurePresets.name: x64-d3d11-only
configurePresets.description: Like x64-debug, without the Vulkan device layer (GZH_RENDER_VULKAN=OFF): no WW3D2/Vulkan, Vulkan packages or dxcompiler.dll. Own build folder build-x64-d3d11-only. Shows that Direct3D 11 builds and runs without Vulkan.

configurePresets.name: x64-vulkan-only
configurePresets.description: Like x64-debug, without the Direct3D 11 device layer (GZH_RENDER_D3D11=OFF): no WW3D2/D3D11, d3d11.lib, dxgi.lib or d3dcompiler.lib. Own build folder build-x64-vulkan-only. Shows that Vulkan builds and runs without Direct3D 11.

configurePresets.name: x64-analyze
configurePresets.description: Like x64-tools with ENABLE_ANALYZE=ON (/analyze /analyze:WX- /analyze:stacksize 100000, root CMakeLists.txt). Own build folder build-x64-analyze, about three times as long as a normal build. Run it before merging to main and when a target is switched to /W4 /WX.
